answer_points.text: A PSI above 0.2 on any feature fires a data drift alert.
The model-health dashboards are reviewed weekly, on Monday morning, by the ML on-call engineer.
A SEV1 page must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.
A written post-mortem is required within 5 business days.
Raw training data is retained for 24 months after collection.
Inference logs are retained for 90 days, then aggregated into daily statistics and the individual records deleted.
A data drift alert is a SEV2 incident: the on-call engineer must acknowledge the page within 1 hour.
The on-call engineer opens the model-health dashboard to confirm which features drifted and whether accuracy dropped.
If accuracy has dropped, the engineer rolls back to the previous model version with the registry action promote previous.
